notes: Long-context coding, text-only, DFlash2 with maximum context. 2026-11-11 profile sweep: DFlash2 K=7 decodes coding work ~1.45x faster than MTP (226 tok/s vs 152, 76% n-gram copy acceptance) and its fit reached 197,632 tokens beside a 0.9 GiB desktop. This profile buys the most context DFlash2 allows: prefill chunk 2048 (~300 MiB less cuBLAS workspace, +~10k tokens) and a 128 MiB fit headroom instead of the 256 default (+~5k, fine on a headless card), so expect ~205k on a card as free as the sweep's and more if you free the card fully. One lane: the measured shape, and the widest fit. Set lanes to 2 if you run agents concurrently (costs a little context).
